app.tagline: Pool several retrieval runs, judge blind with the keyboard, compare systems fairly.
lang.label: Language
save.failed: Could not save to this browser (private mode or storage full). Export a backup from the Export tab so you do not lose your judgments.
resume.found: A saved session was found: {judged} of {total} items judged.
nav.label: Steps
load.drop: Drop your files here, or click to choose
load.formats: Run files (TREC, JSONL, CSV), queries (BEIR queries.jsonl or TSV), corpus (BEIR corpus.jsonl), existing qrels (TREC or BEIR TSV), or a judgepool backup (.jsonl).
load.example.note: Synthetic practice data (made-up product help pages, 6 questions, 3 retrievers). Nothing is uploaded.
runs.title: Retrieval runs
runs.empty: No runs yet. Drop one run file per retrieval setting you want to compare.
runs.name: Run
runs.contribute: Adds documents to the judging pool
runs.help: Documents from pool runs are judged; evaluate-only runs are scored against those judgments. Adding a run to the pool later only asks you to judge its new documents.
pool.title: Pool settings
pool.depth.invalid: Pool depth must be a whole number from 1 to 100.
pool.summary: {queries} queries, {items} items to judge, {pending} still pending.
pool.needs.queries: Also drop a queries file so the judge can read each question.
privacy.note: Everything stays in this browser (IndexedDB). The page is not allowed to make network requests when served by the judgepool command.
judge.empty: Nothing to judge yet. Build a pool on the Load tab.
judge.help.title: Keyboard
judge.help.grades: 0 1 2 3: grade the passage for the question, then jump to the next unjudged item.
judge.help.skip: S: skip (skipped items are not exported). U: undo the last action.
judge.help.move: Left and right arrows: move between items.
judge.help.blind: You never see which system returned a passage, and the order is shuffled with a fixed seed.
judge.help.save: Every judgment is saved in this browser automatically.
judge.alldone: All items are judged. Open the Compare tab.
cmp.avg.trec: questions in run and qrels (trec_eval default)
cmp.warn.tip: Many of this system's top results were never judged
cmp.warn: Pooling bias warning: many top results of {systems} have no judgment (judged@k below {threshold}), so their scores may be lower than they really are. Add them to the pool and judge the new documents before trusting the ranking.
cmp.kdepth: k = {k} is deeper than the pool depth ({depth}), so judged@k cannot reach 1.
cmp.nojudgments: No judgments yet: judge some items to see scores.
cmp.note: nDCG uses the grades as gains; recall, precision and MRR treat grades at or above the chosen level as relevant. Unjudged documents count as not relevant.
export.trec.help: One line per judgment: query_id 0 doc_id grade. Works with trec_eval, ir_measures and ranx.
export.beir.help: Tab-separated with a header: query-id, corpus-id, score. The format BEIR reads.
export.backup.help: Everything (runs, pool, judgments, history). Load it again on the Load tab to continue.
export.truncated: Preview shows the first part only; the download has everything.
export.backup.advice: Browsers can clear site storage. Download a backup now and then.
issue.run.noscore: row has neither a score nor a rank
issue.run.format: cannot recognise this as a run file (TREC, JSONL or CSV)
issue.csv.header: CSV header needs query_id and doc_id columns
issue.trec.run.cols: expected 6 columns (qid Q0 docid rank score tag), found {found}
issue.backup.run: run "{name}" was not declared before its results
issue.backup.meta: this is not a judgepool backup (no meta line)
issue.file.unknown: not a run, queries, corpus, qrels or backup file (see README: Use it with your own data)
